design_parameters.enrich_notes: Corpus is policy/plan submittal fragments plus Section 1207 regional EDB/WQCV (MOP 23, 0.37 in Las Vegas rainfall depth, 24–48 hr EDB detention) and Section 1500 BMP excerpts. On-site dry extended detention requires full WQV drawdown in 72 hr with ≤50% in first 24 hr. Infiltration trench: 0.5 in impervious runoff volume basis, 2 ft SHWT separation, 72 hr max dewatering, 0.3 in/hr minimum obtainable rate (0.5 in/hr stated for infiltration basins). Depressed landscaping (not mapped to bioretention) gives 6–12 in ponding and L:W=2. Landscape swale table: slope ≤1%, depth max 9 in. EDB outlet guidance references Denver UDFCD (2008). Porous pavement and full infiltration basin design pages not in excerpt.
